GR32_VectorUtils>PolygonBoundsFunction

PolygonBounds

Computes the minimal axis-aligned bounding rectangle of a single polygon contour.

Declarations ​

pascal
function PolygonBounds(const Points: TArrayOfFloatPoint): TFloatRect; overload;
function PolygonBounds(const Points: TArrayOfFixedPoint): TFixedRect; overload;

Overload Details

ParameterTypeDescription
PointsTArrayOfFixedPointFixed-point polygon vertices.
TypeDescription

Description ​

PolygonBounds calculates the minimal bounding rectangle enclosing all vertices in Points.
